briefing.headline: OpenAI ships o4 multi-agent system as US-China compute gap narrows

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with o4, Claude 4 and Gemini 2.5 releases. Funding surges past $11B this quarter while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus claiming 40% gains on agent benchmarks. Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 2.5 with real-time video reasoning. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and xAI announce 200k H100 cluster in Texas. TSMC begins 2nm production ramp for NVIDIA Blackwell. Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI be developed by a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium by 2028?
